items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01

ctx.x: Well, one while they called this James Arnold, Kokomo. He played a lot of records. Yes. I knew a... Oh, sure.
Sure, you know Kokomo. I heard him with Johnny Doggs over at the 29... Yeah, sure. That's Kokomo, yeah. Sure. Uh-huh, yeah, that's him. He plays his own company, on guitar.
Where did he come from? Do you know where he came from? I never did know.
